project_info.theme: Celebrity announcement poster for a product launch event
project_info.color_palette: Sky Blue, Soft Peach Pink, White, Neutral Skin Tones, Black Hair

main_subject.detail: A three-person portrait announcement poster introducing guest artists, with large cutout head-and-shoulder portraits of actor Trần Ngọc Vàng, rapper Pháp Kiều, and actor Quốc Anh arranged left, center, and right against a blue-to-pink gradient background.
main_subject.style: Polished celebrity composite poster, editorial retouching, launch-event cast reveal

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes 'NGHỆ SĨ KHÁCH MỜI', 'DIỄN VIÊN TRẦN NGỌC VÀNG', 'RAPPER PHÁP KIỀU', and 'DIỄN VIÊN QUỐC ANH'.
items: Top Left: Large white headline 'NGHỆ SĨ KHÁCH MỜI' spanning the upper third.
Top Right: Soft blue gradient sky area fading into peach pink lower background.
Bottom Left: Portrait of actor Trần Ngọc Vàng wearing glasses and a white blazer, with name caption below.
Bottom Right: Portrait of actor Quốc Anh in a white shirt with his name caption below.
Center/Background: Dominant central portrait of rapper Pháp Kiều in white styling with dramatic earrings, slightly overlapping the other two portraits.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Smooth skin retouching, balanced celebrity key light, glossy editorial finish, clean gradient backdrop

technical_specs.render_style: High fidelity celebrity composite poster design

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for a celebrity guest lineup announcement. Centerpiece is a three-person editorial composite with actor Trần Ngọc Vàng on the left, rapper Pháp Kiều in the center, and actor Quốc Anh on the right. Background is a soft blue-to-peach launch gradient. Surrounding elements: large headline 'NGHỆ SĨ KHÁCH MỜI' and the exact role-name captions 'DIỄN VIÊN TRẦN NGỌC VÀNG', 'RAPPER PHÁP KIỀU', and 'DIỄN VIÊN QUỐC ANH'. Keep the portrait cutout arrangement, polished skin retouching, and cast-announcement hierarchy. Technical style: high fidelity celebrity composite poster design, studio portrait lighting, smooth editorial finish and clean gradient backdrop, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed faces, extra limbs, watermark, signature, cropped
